applies_why: The judge text rules on D5 vs C5 by saying [CR2] G answers the challenger's almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows and leaves the sign's sense open, so it is resolving a pressed point without weighing chain against chain by footing.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: The phrase 'weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse' was read either as requiring assessment of the combined footing of the pressed chain, or as permitting an underdetermined result merely because the isolated sign's sense remains open.
why: The judge leaves D5 UNDERDETERMINED because the sign's sense is open after row answers, which is a verse-by-verse/open-text basis rather than the required chain-against-chain footing analysis.
